billing.subtitle: Your plan, what you use of it, and your payments.
billing.referenceHint: The reference or transaction ID your bank gave you for this transfer.
billing.noPlan: You have no active plan. Choose one below.
billing.pendingNotice: Your payment of {amount} ({invoice}) is waiting for confirmation. Your plan changes once we confirm it.
billing.freeHint: Free plans cannot be chosen here. Contact support to move to one.
billing.manageHint: Only people who can manage billing can change the plan.
billing.invoiceHtmlHint: The invoice as a web page you can open and print
billing.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw the payment of {amount} ({invoice})? Use this if the transfer reference was wrong or you changed your mind. You can pay again afterwards.
billing.plansHint: Upgrades start once we confirm your payment, with your unused days credited. Cheaper plans start when your current period ends.
billing.creditHint: Used first on your next payment.
billing.cancelConfirm: {name} stays active until {date} and then ends. A period you already paid in advance goes to your account credit. You can change your mind until then.
billing.kept: Your plan will renew as usual.
billing.endsOn: Ends on {date}. It will not renew.
billing.movesTo: Moves to {name} on {date}. You pay {amount} when you renew.
billing.change.failed: The price could not be worked out. Try again.
billing.change.startsNow: {name} starts as soon as we confirm your payment, for a full billing period from that day. The days you have not used of your current plan are taken off the price.
billing.change.startsAt: {name} starts on {date}, when your current period ends. No days are lost.
billing.change.downgrade: You keep {current} until {date}. Then you move to {name}: you pay {amount} when you renew, nothing now.
billing.change.downgradeFree: You keep {current} until {date}. Then you move to {name}, free of charge.
billing.change.freeNow: {name} starts now and replaces your current plan.
billing.change.covered: Your account credit covers this. {name} starts as soon as you confirm.
billing.change.surplus: {amount} of unused time is more than the new price: it goes to your account credit.
billing.change.overLimits: You already use more than {name} allows: {items}. What you have stays, but you cannot add more until you are within the limits.
billing.change.overrides: The special limits arranged on your current plan do not carry over to {name}.
billing.waitingHint: Withdraw or wait for the payment that is waiting before choosing another plan.
